meta.notes: Two sources, kept apart. The programme contacts (medical, family support, legal, housing, family advocacy, EFMP, child care, emergency relief) were imported by scripts/import-installations.mjs from the official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS pages for this installation. The agencies Military OneSource does not publish per installation were filled by scripts/import-base-directories.mjs from https://www.tyndall.af.mil/, and Military OneSource itself is copied from national.json. Every contact carries the URL of the page it was read from; nothing here was typed in, inferred, or generated. Where both sources published a number the MilitaryINSTALLATIONS value stands and the base site’s is recorded in that contact’s notes rather than discarded. Still empty here, because no source read published one: command-post, finance, mpf. Re-run either importer to refresh; the diff is the change.

contacts.location: 340 Magnolia Circle Bldg 1465 Tyndall AFB, FL 32403-5612
contacts.notes: Dependents and retirees are not seen in the main Operational Medicine Clinic. However, dependents and retirees are authorized to utilize the 325th MDG; Pharmacy, Basic Labs, and Diagnostic Radiology (X-Ray) ancillary services. For primary care, pediatrics, and other medical services, dependents and retirees are directed to the civilian TRICARE network in the Panama City area.
